verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a compliance SaaS like Sprinto, but the pack has no evidence of bulk export of all customer data in open formats or of an offboarding/data-portability path. The only API-related items are a page title for "Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs" with no stated export scope, and webhooks and push APIs that bring data into Sprinto rather than out of it. No OpenAPI spec was found.
